Read disassembly + decompiled C 2026-07-15 with Ghidra 12.1.2 after DumpDataXrefs.java proved this is the sole writer of DAT_800e3b60 and DAT_800e3b70. Called once per frame from main after FUN_800973e8. Reads two 0x34-byte PsyQ PadInitDirect receive buffers at 0x800e2a68/0x800e2a9c; accepts packets whose status byte is 0 and controller-type high nibble is 4 or 7; combines and inverts the two active-low button bytes. For each port it stores previous held, current held, newly pressed (~previous & current), and newly released (~current & previous) at PTR_DAT_800ac8e8 offsets 0x4c..0x68, then snapshots them to DAT_800e3b58..DAT_800e3b74. Therefore DAT_800e3b60 and DAT_800e3b70 are the newly-pressed words for ports 1 and 2. It separately obtains two additional input words from FUN_8009c5f4 and applies the same edge calculation at offsets 0x6c..0x88 / DAT_800e3c18..DAT_800e3c34, then calls FUN_80021374.
